title: TCG:LGS-B3

objectives.text:
Whenever you play a hero, if there is no Mirror Image in play, put the Mirror counter on that hero and put a Mirror image into zone 5.
If you KO the mirror image, remove the Mirror image and draw a card, and you may play a extra Major hero this round.

If you KO 2 Mirror Images, you win.
